_comment: Copy this file, fill in your details, and pass it with --profile-config
name: Your Full Name

pitch._comment: Body of an application email. Required before apply_email will send anything — without it the email tier skips the job rather than posting a generic letter to a real hiring inbox.
pitch._rules: Concrete beats flattering. Give lines with numbers in them, no adjectives about yourself, no 'I am writing to express my interest', and never a match score.
pitch.opening: One sentence on who you are and the most relevant thing you have shipped.

proof._comment: Keyed by resume variant so the evidence matches the role; 'default' is used when no variant fits.
default: A thing you built, with the number that shows it worked.
A second one. Two is plenty.

pitch.close: Happy to go deeper on any of these. Resume attached.

credentials._note: Credentials are stored separately in OpenClaw auth-profiles.json — never store passwords in this file
